name: cursor
limitations: Emits a project-local `.cursor/` tree (rules + skills + hooks checklist) alongside the generic `aok-bundle.json` import bundle.
Does not emit executable `.cursor/hooks.json` — pack hooks remain checklist guidance (often Claude-oriented).
Does not ship a Cursor marketplace `.cursor-plugin` package; support level remains generated-bundle.

bundle.importInstructions: See docs/adapters/cursor.md. Copy `.cursor/rules` and `.cursor/skills` from bundles/cursor/<pack>/ into the project; keep aok-bundle.json as audit fallback.
